subject: FortisHealth compliance add-ons — staged uplift & credit mechanics
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@fortishealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hashwell.com, security@fortishealth.com
Date: Tue, 26 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: FortisHealth: scope + request for commercial for auditlog/KMS/HSM + residency

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the intro earlier. Fortis is preparing an internal SOW and would like a clear commercial proposal for the following compliance/security items so we can run it through procurement next week:

- Audit log: 7-year retention, immutable export every 90 days, expected ingest ~200GB/month in year 1, ramp to ~800GB/month by year 3.
- KMS: customer-managed keys in our AWS account (us-east-1), integration with our CMKs.
- HSM: hardware-backed signing for a single tenant cluster (we need an estimate for 2 HSM seats and an option for dedicated HSM appliances later).
- Data residency: US-only region requirement for both inference and audit storage.
- HIPAA: Business Associate Addendum and SOC2 evidence checklist (we have an internal security questionnaire pending).

Procurement will evaluate two commercial models: (A) seat-based HSM + flat audit-log ingestion, (B) amortized one-time HSM implementation fee + per-GB audit log. They are specifically asking for:

1) Unit economics for each model (line items + recommended default).
2) A staged uplift / rebate design if we commit to multi-year volume ramp (they want incentives at 50TB and 200TB annual ingest thresholds).
3) Credit treatment for pilot/POC (they expect a pilot credit to offset implementation).
4) Early termination implications (what's refundable vs amortized).

I've attached our internal requirements doc for reference (Attachment: Fortis_Requirements.pdf). Can you get a draft commercial back to me by EOD Thursday (US time)? Procurement is tight on timing.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director, Cloud Procurement
FortisHealth

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@fortishealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FortisHealth: scope + request for commercial for auditlog/KMS/HSM + residency

Elena — thanks, received and appreciate the clear requirements. Summary below and preliminary commercial options attached (Attachment: Redwood_pricing_model_v1.xlsx). I'll flag open items inline.

High-level options (ballpark figures to align on structure; final numbers in the spreadsheet):

Option A — Seat-first (recommended for auditability + low variance)
- HSM: 2 dedicated HSM seats (monthly charge) — $12,000/seat/month (includes firmware/attestation + 24x7 support).
- Implementation: one-time onboarding & HSM integration fee — $45,000 (can be amortized).
- Audit logs: $0.08/GB ingested, with tiered discounts at volume thresholds.
- Residency: US-only routing + audit storage included in ingest price.

Option B — Amortized appliance (lower recurring cost, higher upfront)
- HSM: one-time appliance fee $220,000 (includes 3-year maintenance), optional managed seats thereafter $2,500/seat/month.
- Audit logs: $0.06/GB ingested when committed to 36-month volume.

Pilot & credit proposals
- Offer a $25k pilot credit applied to first invoice if a 6-month pilot converts to committed 12-month term.
- Implementation fee can be converted to a monthly amortized credit across invoices if the customer prefers (default 12 months).

Staged uplift / rebate mechanics (proposed)
- Uplift targets (annual): 50TB and 200TB.
- When a committed threshold is crossed for a 12-month rolling period, apply a retroactive rebate equal to 10% of audit-log charges above threshold (credited on next invoice).
- For HSM seat scale-ups, offer a volume credit equal to 25% of the incremental seat cost for 6 months after scale event.

Early termination
- If customer terminates before amortization completes, remaining amortized implementation balance is due unless termination for cause. For appliance purchases we propose prorated refund after 12 months less a $15k restocking/custom decommission fee.

Open items / asks for procurement
- Confirm target committed annual ingest tiers (for us to firm up discounts).
- Confirm whether Fortis prefers seat-month billing vs appliance amortization.
- Procurement/legal: will you share preferred redlines on limitation of liability and data residency language? Laura from our team is copied to coordinate SOW and contracting.

Next steps
- If this high-level structure looks ok, I'll produce a formal quote + redlines-ready SOW and route it to DocuSign.
- Proposed internal call: Wed 04/27 10:00 PT for pricing/legal alignment — Ben and Laura on our side will attend.

Thanks — happy to talk through details.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@fortishealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hashwell.com
Date: Wed, 27 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: FortisHealth: scope + request for commercial for auditlog/KMS/HSM + residency

Sergio — this is helpful, thanks. A couple quick clarifications before the call: 

1) On the staged rebate: is the rebate applied retroactively to the start of the 12-month rolling period or only from the date the threshold is met? Procurement prefers retroactive to the start of the period.
2) Pilot credit: would the pilot credit be applied against implementation fees first or audit-log usage? We want it to offset onboarding costs primarily.
3) Early termination: Fortis will push for stronger refund mechanics on appliance purchases — can you confirm whether the $15k decommission fee is negotiable for non-enterprise purchases?

We'll confirm headcount for the call, should be Elena + one from security and our procurement manager. We need the formal quote + SOW ahead of that meeting if possible.

Best,
Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@fortishealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Apr 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FortisHealth: scope + request for commercial for auditlog/KMS/HSM + residency

Elena — quick answers to your clarifying questions, copy/paste style so we can record in the call notes: 

On Apr 26, 2028 at 11:03 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com> wrote:
> Staged uplift / rebate mechanics (proposed)
> - Uplift targets (annual): 50TB and 200TB.
> - When a committed threshold is crossed for a 12-month rolling period, apply a retroactive rebate equal to 10% of audit-log charges above threshold (credited on next invoice).

1) Rebate effective date: we can confirm retroactive-to-period-start — that is our default for committed multi-year programs. We'll note that in the formal quote language: "rebate will be applied retroactively to charges billed during the applicable 12-month measurement period."

2) Pilot credit: Pilot credit will be applied to onboarding/implementation line items first, then to first invoice charges if any pilot credit remains. We'll reflect this in the invoice schedule in the SOW.

3) Early termination of appliance: $15k decommission/restocking fee is a starting position. For commercial customers with multi-year appliance purchases we can tier that fee down after 24 months (e.g., 50% refundable after 24 months pro-rata). For procurement-friendly offers we can propose a $10k floor for non-enterprise deals. We'll mark this as negotiable and show alternatives in the commercial appendix.

Operational note: payments & invoicing — our standard practice for amortized implementation is to show the full implementation charge on the invoice and then apply an internal amortization credit line across subsequent invoices (transparent to customer). If you prefer we can surface amortization as a separate monthly line item instead.

I'll prepare a draft SOW (Attachment: SOW-draft-Fortis.docx) and a ready-to-sign quote; Sergio will share the DocuSign link once Laura signs off on contractual language.

See you on the call — Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
